reviews.title: Perfect for Corsair ccxt and argb fans
reviews.comment: If you’re having problems with this cable, stop what you’re doing and hire a professional because you’re over your head.  I see so many people trying to use these and giving bad reviews.  Cable works fine and yes it works with Corsair if you know what you’re doing.  This is perfect for Corsair 4 pin connector on commander core xt to argb fans.  Anyone who says this doesn’t work is wrong including Corsair!
reviews.author: B. Meireis
